findings.claim: The diff reaches `.claude/rules/design-decisions.md`, a repository-wide rules file that is not one of the implicit touch points (docs/specs, INDEX.md, docs/process/reviews); no invariants file exists, so there is no declared touch-point list that names it.
findings.impact: No runtime effect. A new standing rule ('Unlock and Lock end in a full page load') now binds every future change to auth flows; a person should confirm that adding a project-wide rule was intended as part of this fix.
findings.evidence: .claude/rules/design-decisions.md:9 (added bullet). The Lock half of the rule matches code at frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx:64-65 (`await lockApi(); window.location.href = "/"`); the /unlock half matches frontend/src/app/unlock/page.tsx:37.

bucket_proposal.reason: No invariant is declared, so nothing is broken; this is only a place reached outside a (nonexistent) touch-point list.

findings.claim: The setup wizard also grants an unlock session (SetupWizard.tsx:287 `await unlock(password.password, false)`) and then navigates client-side with `router.push("/admin")` (CompleteStep.tsx:58), so it is an unlock path that does not end in a full page load, unlike the /unlock page after this change.
findings.impact: After finishing first-run setup in protected mode, providers mounted in the root layout (WebSocketProvider, AddonSlotsProvider, sidebar data via useSidebarData's mount-time getDrives/getAuthStatus, frontend/src/components/sidebar/useSidebarData.ts:43-46) may keep state read under the pre-unlock cookie until a reload. Happens at most once per install.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/app/setup/SetupWizard.tsx:281-291 unlocks; frontend/src/app/setup/steps/CompleteStep.tsx:58 router.push('/admin'); frontend/src/app/layout.tsx:73-87 mounts WebSocketProvider/AddonSlotsProvider/SidebarProvider above every page including /setup. Whether the Sidebar component is actually mounted on /setup (AppShell.tsx:367) and whether the WS filter matters before passwords exist was not established.

bucket_proposal.reason: No declared invariant; the code path was not touched by this change and reads inconsistent with the new rules bullet and with the stated fix rationale.

findings.proposed_fix: Decide whether CompleteStep should end in window.location.assign('/admin') when the wizard unlocked a session; out of this change's scope unless a person extends it.

specification_compliance: behavior.md (UNSPEC fix-unlock-refresh): successful unlock ends in a full page load of the redirect target — met by page.tsx:37 `window.location.assign(resolveRedirect())`.
Redirect sanitising is unchanged: same-origin path starting with '/' and not '//' is used, otherwise '/' (page.tsx:18-24).
Wrong password / failed request leave the viewer on /unlock with the error — unchanged branches page.tsx:38-43.
next.config.ts sets no basePath or assetPrefix (only the next-intl plugin), so switching from router.push to location.assign does not lose a path prefix.
Design-decision 'locked drive hidden / 404' is not touched by this change.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: After a successful unlock the `finally` block sets loading=false, so the submit button re-enables while the full page load is still in flight and a second click sends another unlock request.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: Triggered only by clicking submit again during the brief page load; the second POST is harmless and the user still lands on the target.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: The /unlock page remains in browser history after the full page load, so Back returns to the unlock form (same as the previous router.push behavior).
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: Pressing Back after unlocking shows the password form again; nothing is lost.

regression_risks: Any future basePath in next.config.ts would not be prepended by window.location.assign, unlike router.push.
Full page load discards any in-memory client state (e.g., UploadProgress) that was live while on /unlock; unlikely to be active on that page.
